The '''Nembus sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], located near the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Praadost II/Legends|Praadost II]] and [[Carosi XII]].
